answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The thread is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ridge. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
